note: FNS 1034.2 simply directs reviewers to Section 512 (data matching requirements via IEVS) for negative allegations of unemployment compensation. The OLG covers this functionally through DTA's PI Checklist system for unemployment, which is the state's implementation of IEVS data matching for UC income. The OLG's Simplified Reporting Examples page contains extensive Q&A (Q8-Q13+) on handling PI Checklist unemployment matches, including procedures for entering UC income found via data match, verifying claim status through the DUA system/UI Online, and handling discrepancies between UC claims and existing wage records. While the OLG uses DTA-specific terminology (PI Checklist, DUA system) rather than federal terminology (IEVS, negative allegation), the substantive requirement — using data matching to identify UC income when a household doesn't report it — is thoroughly covered with detailed worker procedures.
